classes.name: NativePlanExecutionLifecycle
classes.description: Deep private Chisei module whose interface executes one cached native ExecutionPlan and owns lookup-first short-circuit, live evaluation regression gate, residency/privacy/egress rechecks, provider streaming, evolve/scoring bookkeeping, and terminal receipt completion.

classes.name: ChiseiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates native plan execution callers, translates protocol messages, and delegates to Native plan execution.

relations.name: delegates_native_plan_execution_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates native plan execution after caller authentication and enterprise context extraction.
